title: Alignment of Large Language Models with Constrained Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Automated scoring using reward/cost models (e.g., Beaver-cost, GPT2-harmlessness) and a GPT-4-based evaluator prompted to specifically penalize discrimination, stereotypes, and injustice as part of a broader harmlessness and safety evaluation.
Qualitative evaluation through red-teaming experiments, analyzing the models' generated responses to adversarial prompts that express homophobic prejudice.
